Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Shashi Kant Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Shamim Ahmed,J.
This writ petition has been filed, inter alia, for the following reliefs;
"i.

To, issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned recovery certificate no. 407/READER (E)/2019 dt. 14.10.2019 issued by Respondent No. 3 and the recovery citation dated 11.11.2019 issued by Respondent No. 4 being illegal and without jurisdiction.

ii. To, issue, a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents authority not to realize the amount in pursuance to the recovery certificate no. 407/READER (E)/2019 dt. 14.10.2019 issued by Respondent No. 3 and the recovery citation dated 11.11.2019 issued by Respondent No. 4."

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that by order dated 30.6.2015 a penalty of Rs. 3 lacs each was imposed against the petitioner, M/S Sodexo Food Solution India Pvt. Ltd, its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh as well as M/s Krishna Trading Corporation, Delhi by Respondent No. 3, ADM (E), Gautam Buddha Nagar under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short "the Act") for violation of Section 26 (2) (II) R/w Section 3 (1) (ZX) of the Act.

entities.text: Sodexo Food Solution India Pvt. Ltd
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Against the said order, petitioner-company as well as its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh preferred an appeal under Section 70 of the Act wherein Tribunal stayed the recovery against the petitioner-company and its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh in case theydeposit 50%
of the penalty imposed by the Respondent No. 3 against both of them, meaning thereby the petitioner-company as well as its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh were directed to deposit 50% only (i.e. Rs. 1,50,000/- each totalling Rs. 3,00,000/-) out of Rs. 6,00,000/- (rupees six lacs).

According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner-company and its Director/Manager Mr. R. Prasanna Venkatesh have already deposited half of the fine amount i.e. Rs. 1,50,000/- each totalling Rs. 3,00,000/- in pursuance of the order dated 6.8.2015 passed by the Tribunal but still recovery citation has been issued against the petitioner instead of M/s Krishna Trading Corporation,
Delhi, which did not prefer any appeal against the order dated 30.6.2015 passed by the Respondent No. 3.

He further submitted that since the petitioner-company and its Director/Manager Mr. R.
Prasanna Venkatesh have already deposited half of the penalty amount imposed upon them and the recovery for the balance amount is stayed, no fresh recovery citation or recovery certificate can be issued by the Respondent No. 3 against the petitioner-company and its Director/Manager Mr. R.
Prasanna Venkatesh during the pendency of the appeal.
We find substance in the argument of the learned counsel for the petitioner.

Neither any recovery certificate nor recovery citation could have been issued against the petitioner as the petitioner has already deposited half of the penalty amount imposed upon him in pursuance of the order dated 6.8.2015 passed by the tribunal.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, we grant liberty to the petitioner to make a comprehensive representation before the Respondent No. 3, ADM (E) ventilating its grievances within two weeks from today along with a certified copy of this order enclosing therewith a copy of the writ petition and its annexures and, if any such representation is made, the said authority shall make all endeavour to consider and decide the same by a speaking and reasoned order after taking into consideration the order dated 6.8.2015 passed by the tribunal in accordance with law expeditiously preferably within four weeks from the date of receipt of the said representation.
Till the order is passed on the representation of the petitioner, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner.
